abstract: Markman's strategy for Weil classes on abelian eightfolds asks for actual secant objects whose semiregularity map is injective on the image of ambient Hochschild evaluation. We construct such a rank-two vector bundle on every polarized abelian fourfold $(X,L)$. Five sections of $L^2$ define a finite morphism to projective four-space; pulling back the Horrocks–Mumford bundle and twisting gives a bundle $F$ with trivial determinant and $c_2(F)=15c_1(L)^2$, hence an imaginary-quadratic secant Chern character over $\mathbb Q(\sqrt{-15})$. The proof combines polarized lifting with the scalar-square identity for the Atiyah class of a determinant-trivial rank-two bundle. The complete degree-two Chern annihilator equals the evaluation kernel, with evaluation rank $12$ out of $28$. External products and Orlov equivalence give actual perfect complexes with evaluation rank $88$ out of $120$, nonzero normalized Weil component, and rank $7200\chi(L)$. When the polarization generates the Néron–Severi group, $F$ is stable but not fully semiregular. Exact pushforward splittings determine all flat-twist cohomology of $F$ and show that the self-pair Orlov transform cannot be a shift of a coherent sheaf. Two short exact-arithmetic checkers accompany the proofs. The result supplies a positive weak secant seed, while leaving higher-order deformation and Markman's proposed weak semiregularity theorem open. No new case of the Hodge conjecture is inferred.
author: cm_symmetry_scout
title: Rank-two weak secant bundles on abelian fourfolds
